#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
HANDOFF_JSON="${HERMCLAW_HANDOFF_JSON:-/tmp/hermclaw-benutzerfilter-handoff.json}"
DISCOVERY_TARGET="${HERMCLAW_DISCOVERY_TARGET:-/tmp/hermclaw-detdisc-target}"
ORIGINAL_BASE_BRANCH="${HERMCLAW_ORIGINAL_BASE_BRANCH:-redesign/autonomous-agent}"
LITELLM_URL="${HERMCLAW_LITELLM_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:4000/v1/chat/completions}"
HEAVY_ALIAS="${HERMCLAW_HEAVY_ALIAS:-local-coder-qwen38-24k}"
MAX_CORRECTIONS="${HERMCLAW_MAX_CORRECTIONS:-1}"
PIPELINE_RESULT="${HERMCLAW_PIPELINE_RESULT:-/tmp/hermclaw-pipeline-result.json}"
RESUME_META="${HERMCLAW_RESUME_META:-}"

cd "$ROOT"

if [[ ! -s "$HANDOFF_JSON" ]]; then
  echo "FEHLER: Handoff fehlt: $HANDOFF_JSON"
  exit 40
fi

echo "===== HANDOFF-VERTRAG NORMALISIEREN ====="
python3 -m model_runtime.normalize_handoff \
  --input "$HANDOFF_JSON" \
  --output "$HANDOFF_JSON"

if [[ -d "$DISCOVERY_TARGET/.git" ]]; then
  VERIFY_BASE_COMMIT="$(git -C "$DISCOVERY_TARGET" rev-parse HEAD)"
else
  VERIFY_BASE_COMMIT="$(git ls-remote git@hermclaw-gitlab:local-ai/hermclaw.git "refs/heads/$ORIGINAL_BASE_BRANCH" | awk '{print $1}')"
fi

if [[ -z "$VERIFY_BASE_COMMIT" ]]; then
  echo "FEHLER: Basis-Commit konnte nicht bestimmt werden."
  exit 41
fi

CURRENT_BASE="$ORIGINAL_BASE_BRANCH"
TASK_FILE=""
ITERATION=0
LAST_BRANCH=""
LAST_META=""
LAST_VERIFY=""
LAST_HEAVY=""
RESUME_PENDING=0

if [[ -n "$RESUME_META" ]]; then
  if [[ ! -s "$RESUME_META" ]]; then
    echo "FEHLER: Resume-Metadaten fehlen: $RESUME_META"
    exit 42
  fi
  RESUME_PENDING=1
  echo "[PIPELINE] Resume-Metadaten erkannt: $RESUME_META"
fi

while true; do
  JOB_ID="routing-v02-main-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)-i${ITERATION}-$$"
  RUN_META="/tmp/hermclaw-main-${JOB_ID}.json"
  RUN_LOG="/tmp/hermclaw-main-${JOB_ID}.log"

  echo
  echo "============================================================"

  if [[ "$RESUME_PENDING" == "1" ]]; then
    echo "===== PIPELINE RESUME / BESTEHENDES MAIN-ERGEBNIS ====="
    echo "============================================================"
    RUN_META="$RESUME_META"
    RESULT_BRANCH="$(python3 - "$RUN_META" <<'PY'
import json, sys
obj=json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
print(obj['branch'])
PY
)"
    RESUME_PENDING=0
    echo "[PIPELINE] Resume-Branch: $RESULT_BRANCH"
  else
    echo "===== PIPELINE MAIN RUN ${ITERATION} ====="
    echo "============================================================"

    HERMCLAW_HANDOFF_JSON="$HANDOFF_JSON" \
    HERMCLAW_BASE_BRANCH="$CURRENT_BASE" \
    HERMCLAW_JOB_ID="$JOB_ID" \
    HERMCLAW_TASK_FILE="$TASK_FILE" \
    HERMCLAW_RUN_META="$RUN_META" \
    HERMCLAW_RUN_LOG="$RUN_LOG" \
      bash "$ROOT/model_runtime/run_main_from_handoff.sh"

    RESULT_BRANCH="$(python3 - "$RUN_META" <<'PY'
import json, sys
obj=json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
print(obj['branch'])
PY
)"
  fi

  LAST_BRANCH="$RESULT_BRANCH"
  LAST_META="$RUN_META"

  VERIFY_DIR="/tmp/hermclaw-verify-${JOB_ID}"
  VERIFY_JSON="/tmp/hermclaw-verify-${JOB_ID}.json"
  DIFF_FILE="/tmp/hermclaw-diff-${JOB_ID}.patch"
  HEAVY_JSON="/tmp/hermclaw-heavy-${JOB_ID}.json"
  SANITIZE_JSON="/tmp/hermclaw-sanitize-${JOB_ID}.json"

  echo
  echo "===== DETERMINISTISCHE VERIFIKATION ====="
  rm -rf "$VERIFY_DIR"
  git clone --quiet --single-branch --branch "$RESULT_BRANCH" \
    git@hermclaw-gitlab:local-ai/hermclaw.git "$VERIFY_DIR"

  echo "===== STRICT-TARGET SANITIZER ====="
  python3 -m model_runtime.sanitize_result_branch \
    --repo "$VERIFY_DIR" \
    --base-ref "$VERIFY_BASE_COMMIT" \
    --handoff "$HANDOFF_JSON" \
    --output "$SANITIZE_JSON"

  set +e
  python3 -m model_runtime.deterministic_verifier \
    --repo "$VERIFY_DIR" \
    --base-ref "$VERIFY_BASE_COMMIT" \
    --handoff "$HANDOFF_JSON" \
    --output "$VERIFY_JSON" \
    --diff-output "$DIFF_FILE"
  VERIFY_RC=$?
  set -e

  LAST_VERIFY="$VERIFY_JSON"

  if [[ ! -s "$VERIFY_JSON" ]]; then
    echo "FEHLER: Verifier hat keinen Report erzeugt."
    exit 43
  fi

  if [[ $VERIFY_RC -ne 0 ]]; then
    echo
    echo "===== DETERMINISTISCHE KORREKTUR ENTSCHEIDUNG ====="
    echo "[PIPELINE] Verifier hat Blocker gefunden; Heavy Review wird bis nach deren Behebung übersprungen."
    python3 - "$VERIFY_JSON" "$HEAVY_JSON" <<'PY'
import json, sys
verifier_path, output_path = sys.argv[1:]
verifier = json.load(open(verifier_path, encoding='utf-8'))
issues = []
for item in verifier.get('blockers', []):
    code = str(item.get('code', 'BLOCKER'))
    message = str(item.get('message', '')).strip()
    paths = item.get('paths') or []
    path = str(item.get('path', '')).strip()
    if not path and isinstance(paths, list) and paths:
        path = ', '.join(str(p) for p in paths)
    evidence = str(item.get('evidence', '')).strip()
    if not evidence:
        evidence = json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False)
    issues.append({
        'severity': 'blocker',
        'path': path,
        'evidence': f'{code}: {evidence}',
        'required_change': message or f'Blocker {code} beheben.',
    })
result = {
    'schema': 1,
    'verdict': 'corrections',
    'summary': f'Deterministischer Verifier meldet {len(issues)} Blocker.',
    'issues': issues,
    'tests_to_run': verifier.get('acceptance_requirements', {}).get('tests', []),
    'verifier_ok': False,
    '_generated_by': 'deterministic_verifier',
}
open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(
    json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n'
)
PY
    HEAVY_RC=30
  else
    echo
    echo "===== HEAVY REVIEW / 27B / 24K ====="
    python3 -m model_runtime.model_manager prepare heavy

    set +e
    python3 -m model_runtime.heavy_review \
      --handoff "$HANDOFF_JSON" \
      --verifier "$VERIFY_JSON" \
      --diff "$DIFF_FILE" \
      --output "$HEAVY_JSON" \
      --endpoint "$LITELLM_URL" \
      --model "$HEAVY_ALIAS"
    HEAVY_RC=$?
    set -e
  fi

  LAST_HEAVY="$HEAVY_JSON"

  VERDICT="$(python3 - "$HEAVY_JSON" <<'PY'
import json, sys
obj=json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
print(obj.get('verdict', 'corrections'))
PY
)"

  VERIFY_OK="$(python3 - "$VERIFY_JSON" <<'PY'
import json, sys
obj=json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
print('1' if obj.get('ok') else '0')
PY
)"

  HEAVY_SOURCE="$(python3 - "$HEAVY_JSON" <<'PY'
import json, sys
obj=json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
print(obj.get('_generated_by', 'unknown'))
PY
)"

  echo
  echo "===== PIPELINE-GATE ====="
  echo "[PIPELINE] result_branch: $RESULT_BRANCH"
  echo "[PIPELINE] verifier_ok:  $VERIFY_OK (rc=$VERIFY_RC)"
  echo "[PIPELINE] heavy_verdict: $VERDICT (rc=$HEAVY_RC, source=$HEAVY_SOURCE)"

  if [[ "$HEAVY_SOURCE" == "fail_closed" ]]; then
    python3 - "$PIPELINE_RESULT" "$RESULT_BRANCH" "$RUN_META" "$VERIFY_JSON" "$HEAVY_JSON" "$ITERATION" <<'PY'
import json, sys
out, branch, meta, verifier, heavy, iteration = sys.argv[1:]
result = {
    'ok': False,
    'branch': branch,
    'run_meta': meta,
    'verifier_report': verifier,
    'heavy_review': heavy,
    'correction_iterations': int(iteration),
    'reason': 'heavy_review_fail_closed',
}
open(out, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
PY
    echo "[PIPELINE] STOP: Heavy Review selbst war nicht belastbar; keine sinnlose Code-Korrekturrunde."
    echo "[PIPELINE] Ergebnis: $PIPELINE_RESULT"
    exit 51
  fi

  if [[ "$VERIFY_OK" == "1" && "$VERDICT" == "pass" ]]; then
    python3 - "$PIPELINE_RESULT" "$RESULT_BRANCH" "$RUN_META" "$VERIFY_JSON" "$HEAVY_JSON" "$ITERATION" <<'PY'
import json, sys
out, branch, meta, verifier, heavy, iteration = sys.argv[1:]
result = {
    'ok': True,
    'branch': branch,
    'run_meta': meta,
    'verifier_report': verifier,
    'heavy_review': heavy,
    'correction_iterations': int(iteration),
}
open(out, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
PY
    echo "[PIPELINE] PASS. Vollautomatische Pipeline abgeschlossen."
    echo "[PIPELINE] Ergebnis: $PIPELINE_RESULT"
    exit 0
  fi

  if (( ITERATION >= MAX_CORRECTIONS )); then
    python3 - "$PIPELINE_RESULT" "$RESULT_BRANCH" "$RUN_META" "$VERIFY_JSON" "$HEAVY_JSON" "$ITERATION" <<'PY'
import json, sys
out, branch, meta, verifier, heavy, iteration = sys.argv[1:]
result = {
    'ok': False,
    'branch': branch,
    'run_meta': meta,
    'verifier_report': verifier,
    'heavy_review': heavy,
    'correction_iterations': int(iteration),
    'reason': 'max_corrections_reached',
}
open(out, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
PY
    echo "[PIPELINE] STOP: Nach $ITERATION Korrekturrunde(n) kein belastbarer PASS."
    echo "[PIPELINE] Ergebnis: $PIPELINE_RESULT"
    exit 50
  fi

  ITERATION=$((ITERATION + 1))
  CORRECTION_TASK="/tmp/hermclaw-correction-${JOB_ID}.txt"

  echo
  echo "===== AUTOMATISCHE KORREKTURRUNDE ${ITERATION} ====="
  python3 -m model_runtime.review_correction_task \
    --handoff "$HANDOFF_JSON" \
    --verifier "$VERIFY_JSON" \
    --heavy "$HEAVY_JSON" \
    > "$CORRECTION_TASK"

  CURRENT_BASE="$RESULT_BRANCH"
  TASK_FILE="$CORRECTION_TASK"
  echo "[PIPELINE] Korrektur startet automatisch auf Basis: $CURRENT_BASE"
done
